sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.

sentences.en: We have some news from within our Fox family.
sentences.zh: 我们福克斯大家庭内部有一些消息。

sentences.en: Less than a week after Fox News reached a historic settlement in a defamation lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 在福克斯新闻就一场诽谤诉讼达成历史性令和解不到一周后。

sentences.en: Fox News Media and Tucker Carlson have mutually agreed to part ways.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻传媒与塔克·卡尔森已达成一致，双方分道扬镳。

sentences.en: The network has abruptly fired Tucker Carlson, an anchor at the center of that case.
sentences.zh: 该电视网突然解雇了作为该案件核心人物的主播塔克·卡尔森。

sentences.en: We want to thank Tucker Carlson for his service to the network as a host and prior to that as a long-term contributor.
sentences.zh: 我们要感谢塔克·卡尔森作为主持人以及在此之前作为长期撰稿人为电视网所做出的贡献。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Jeremy Peters, on exactly why Fox is cutting ties with its biggest star and what Fox will be without him.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事杰里米·彼得斯将详细讲述为什么福克斯要切断与这位头牌明星的联系，以及没有了他，福克斯将会怎样。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, April 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月25日，星期二。

sentences.en: Jeremy, you're back very soon.
sentences.zh: 杰里米，你这么快就回来了。

sentences.en: Sooner than perhaps you expected.
sentences.zh: 比你预期的可能还要快。

sentences.en: Sooner than perhaps you wanted.
sentences.zh: 比你想要的可能还要快。

sentences.en: Sooner than I think anyone might have expected.
sentences.zh: 比我认为任何人预期的都要快。

sentences.en: So, it is 6.26 p.m.
sentences.zh: 现在是下午6点26分，

sentences.en: on Monday night, and four blocks away from here, Jeremy, over at the headquarters of Fox News,
sentences.zh: 星期一晚上，离这里四个街区远的地方，杰里米，在福克斯新闻总部那边，

sentences.en: there is a mad scramble going on right now because there will be no Tucker Carlson tonight at 8 p.m., as it is always aired, because Tucker Carlson has been fired.
sentences.zh: 现在正手忙脚乱，因为今晚8点不会有往常播出的《塔克·卡尔森今晚秀》了，因为塔克·卡尔森被解雇了。

sentences.en: And I just want to begin by having you put that piece of news into perspective for us as somebody who covers Fox, covers the entire conservative media world.
sentences.zh: 我只想先请你作为一名报道福克斯、报道整个保守派媒体世界的记者，帮我们把这条新闻放在大背景下来看待。

sentences.en: How big a moment this is.
sentences.zh: 这是一个多么重大的时刻。

sentences.en: It's an earthquake.
sentences.zh: 这是一场地震。

sentences.en: Tucker Carlson was one of these rare media figures whose power transcended what he could say to his audience
sentences.zh: 塔克·卡尔森是那种罕见的媒体人物，他的影响力超越了他对观众所说的话，

sentences.en: because he not only spoke to them, he could speak to the people in power in the highest places of American government.
sentences.zh: 因为他不仅在对观众说话，他还能与美国政府最高层的权贵对话。

sentences.en: And that included, for a time, the president of the United States, Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，这其中甚至包括美国总统唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They corresponded, you know, meaningfully and regularly.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们有过有意义且规律的通信。

sentences.en: And Tucker could have an influence on the president.
sentences.zh: 塔克能够对总统产生影响。

sentences.en: When he wanted his ear, he could have it.
sentences.zh: 当他想让总统听取意见时，他就能做到。

sentences.en: Because Tucker Carlson spoke the language of Trump supporters more intuitively than almost anyone in conservative media.
sentences.zh: 因为塔克·卡尔森比保守派媒体中的几乎任何人都能更直观地说出特朗普支持者的心声。

sentences.en: And that allowed him to become one of the most powerful, if not the most powerful host on television.
sentences.zh: 这使他成为电视上最强大的主持人之一，如果不是最强大的话。

sentences.en: And now he's gone.
sentences.zh: 而现在他走了。

sentences.en: And we're going to get to why he's gone in just a moment or why we think he is gone.
sentences.zh: 我们马上就会谈到他为什么离开，或者我们认为他为什么离开。

sentences.en: But talk to us about how, once he had this show, Tucker Carlson became this powerful force that you're describing
sentences.zh: 但请跟我们讲讲，一旦他拥有了这个节目，塔克·卡尔森是如何成为你所描述的这股强大力量的，

sentences.en: and that has made his departure the earthquake that you just called it.
sentences.zh: 正是这种力量，让他的离职成为了你刚才所说的地震。

sentences.en: So, before Donald Trump bursts onto the political scene, Tucker Carlson is not a terribly influential person in conservative politics.
sentences.zh: 所以在唐纳德·特朗普闯入政治舞台之前，塔克·卡尔森在保守派政治中并不是一个很有影响力的人物。

sentences.en: I mean, he's the weekend anchor at Fox.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他只是福克斯的周末主播。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: Which is, we should say, for those who don't obsess about ratings on cable news, not at all prestigious.
sentences.zh: 我们要说的是，对于那些不痴迷于有线新闻收视率的人来说，这完全谈不上声望。

sentences.en: It's kind of an oblivion role.
sentences.zh: 这有点像一个被遗忘的角色。

sentences.en: Yeah, I believe there's a Simpsons joke about this where Kent Brockman, the anchor, gets upset one day and storms off and says, I don't care, call the weekend guy.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想《辛普森一家》里有个关于这个的笑话，主播肯特·布罗克曼有一天生气了，气冲冲地走开说，我不在乎，叫周末的那个人来。

sentences.en: Okay, so he's not yet Tucker Carlson, as we know him.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以他还不是我们所熟知的那个塔克·卡尔森。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 但特朗普总统任期被证明是他职业生涯中迄今为止最大的一记运气。

sentences.en: His ability to speak to the Trump voter, to their grievances, their anxieties about the way they see their purchase on power in American society slipping away.
sentences.zh: 他能够对特朗普选民说话，说出他们的不满，说出他们对于自己在美国社会中对权力的掌握正在逐渐流失的焦虑。

sentences.en: That is what his gift is.

sentences.zh: 这就是比尔·奥莱利在福克斯新闻时占据的时段，在他被解雇之前，他曾是他们的头牌主持人。

sentences.en: So we looked into this for a documentary from a Tucker Carlson original series called The End of Men.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们为塔克·卡尔森原创系列节目中一部名为《男性的终结》的纪录片对此进行了调查。

sentences.en: And he does an entire special on this supposed assault on masculinity in this country.
sentences.zh: 他专门针对这个国家所谓对男子气概的攻击做了一期特别节目。

sentences.en: Can you quantify just how powerfully it's connecting with them?

sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Well, lo and behold, Texas Governor Greg Abbott sending 400 more National Guard troops to the El Paso border in an attempt to block the flow of migrants into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，说时迟那时快，德克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特向埃尔帕索边境派遣了400名国民警卫队士兵，试图阻止移民涌入美国。

sentences.en: Abbott later says he'll do just that.
sentences.zh: 阿博特后来表示他会这么做的。

sentences.en: He sends in the Texas National Guard to the border.
sentences.zh: 他把得克萨斯州国民警卫队派到了边境。

sentences.en: I mean, I just want to pause, and we've talked about that incident on the show.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我只是想暂停一下，我们在节目中讨论过那个事件。

sentences.en: We actually spoke to a member of the National Guard in Texas about it.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上就此事采访了一位得克萨斯州国民警卫队的成员。

sentences.en: What a big deal it is to mobilize your National Guard.
sentences.zh: 动员你的国民警卫队是一件多么大不了的事啊。

sentences.en: I mean, in this case, mobilize your National Guard to act as a kind of, like, border patrol.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在这种情况下，动员你的国民警卫队来充当某种类似于边境巡逻队的角色。

sentences.en: And that is being prompted not by an outcry from voters or an order from the president, but by a cable news anchor suggesting it.
sentences.zh: 而这并不是由选民的强烈抗议或总统的命令引发的，而是由有线新闻主播的提议引发的。

sentences.en: That's power.
sentences.zh: 这就是权力。

sentences.en: Indeed it is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Here's another.
sentences.zh: 这里还有另一个。

sentences.en: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis is taking credit for flying two planes carrying dozens of migrants to Martha's Vineyard.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯正因用飞机将几十名移民运送到玛莎葡萄园岛而邀功。

sentences.en: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis sends migrants to Martha's Vineyard in this stunt to say,
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯在这场噱头中将移民送到玛莎葡萄园岛，意在表明，

sentences.en: OK, blue states, see, this is what it's like.
sentences.zh: 好吧，蓝州，看，这就是它的样子。

sentences.en: You deal with these people.
sentences.zh: 你们来应付这些人吧。

sentences.en: Many did not know where they were going, and local officials on the island were not given any advanced notice of the flight's arrival.
sentences.zh: 许多人不知道他们要去哪里，岛上的地方官员也没有得到任何关于航班到达的提前通知。

sentences.en: That was Tucker Carlson's idea.
sentences.zh: 那是塔克·卡尔森的主意。

sentences.en: As of 2019, only 3% of all people, all residents in Eggertown were born outside of this country.
sentences.zh: 截至2019年，埃格托恩所有人口、所有居民中，只有3%是在这个国家之外出生的。

sentences.en: They are begging for more diversity.
sentences.zh: 他们正在恳求更多的多样性。

sentences.en: Why not send migrants there?
sentences.zh: 为什么不把移民送到那里去呢？

sentences.en: In huge numbers.
sentences.zh: 数量庞大地。

sentences.en: Earlier on his show, he said that residents of Martha's Vineyard, who are almost all Democrats, are, quote, begging for more diversity.
sentences.zh: 此前在他的节目中，他说玛莎葡萄园岛的居民几乎全都是民主党人，他们，引述一下，在恳求更多的多样性。

sentences.en: Why not send migrants there?
sentences.zh: 为什么不把移民送到那里去呢？

sentences.en: Well, that's what DeSantis did.
sentences.zh: 好吧，德桑蒂斯就是这么做的。

sentences.en: So over and over again, the words come out of Tucker Carlson's mouth, and these powerful governors obediently do what he's asking for,
sentences.zh: 所以一次又一次，这些话从塔克·卡尔森嘴里说出来，而这些有权势的州长们则顺从地做着他要求的事，

sentences.en: which is, I suppose, a measure of their fear that if they don't, his audience will come and punish them at the polls.
sentences.zh: 我想，这也衡量出他们的恐惧，即如果他们不这么做，他的观众就会在投票箱前惩罚他们。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: They know to be on the wrong side of Tucker Carlson, and one of his issues is to risk incurring the wrath of the conservative voter.
sentences.zh: 他们知道站在塔克·卡尔森的对立面会怎么样，而他的议题之一就是冒着招致保守派选民愤怒的风险。

sentences.en: No one knows this better than Kevin McCarthy, the Speaker of the House, who almost wasn't the Speaker of the House because conservatives like Tucker Carlson told their followers
sentences.zh: 没有人比众议院议长凯文·麦卡锡更清楚这一点了，他差一点就当不成众议院议长了，因为像塔克·卡尔森这样的保守派告诉他们的追随者，

sentences.en: that he was too cozy with the elite ruling class in business and politics.
sentences.zh: 他与商业和政治领域的精英统治阶层过于亲密。

sentences.en: So to placate Carlson, McCarthy gives him 40,000 hours of previously unseen footage from the security tapes that were running on January 6th.
sentences.zh: 因此为了抚慰卡尔森，麦卡锡给了他4万小时此前从未公开的1月6日骚乱期间的监控录像。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A kind of unprecedented disclosure to a single journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 一种对单个记者的前所未有的披露。

sentences.en: And one that many Democrats pointed out risked a real security breach by disclosing certain aspects of capital security that weren't known to the public.
sentences.zh: 许多民主党人指出，此举通过披露公众所不知道的国会山安保的某些方面，带来了真正的安全漏洞风险。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Carlson takes this footage and edits it down to a handful of incidents where you can see
sentences.zh: 卡尔森拿到这段录像后，将其剪辑到只有少数几个事件的片段，在这些片段中你可以看到，

sentences.en: the people who had illegally broken into the Capitol walking around peacefully, looking as if they might be on just a leisurely tour.
sentences.zh: 那些非法闯入国会大厦的人在里面平静地走来走去，看起来就像是在进行一次悠闲的参观。

sentences.en: And he says, see, they told you that this was a violent mob, but it's not.
sentences.zh: 他说，看，他们告诉你们这是一场暴力暴民事件，但其实并不是。

sentences.en: And in fact, many of these people just, you know, kind of innocently ambled into the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这些人中的许多人只是，你知道的，有点天真地溜达进了国会大厦。

sentences.en: And in a trick that he has tried time and time again on his show, he says, I'm telling you the truth about what happened here.
sentences.zh: 通过他在节目中屡试不爽的把戏，他说，我是在向你们讲述这里发生事情的真相。

sentences.en: The mainstream liberal media are the ones who are lying to you and you can't believe them here.
sentences.zh: 主流自由派媒体才是对你们撒谎的人，在这里你们不能相信他们。

sentences.en: See it for yourself.
sentences.zh: 亲眼看看吧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which is not accurate in this case.
sentences.zh: 但这在这种情况下并不准确。

sentences.en: But the scale of influence we're talking about here is the envy of the cable news industry.
sentences.zh: 但我们在这里谈论的影响力规模，是整个有线新闻行业艳羡的对象。

sentences.en: I mean, other hosts and other networks, they might not like what Tucker Carlson is doing, but they no doubt wish they had that kind of influence.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，其他主持人和别的电视网，他们可能不喜欢塔克·卡尔森在做的事，但他们无疑希望自己也有那种影响力。

sentences.en: They wish they had his ratings.
sentences.zh: 他们希望自己也有他的收视率。

sentences.en: And by all accounts, Fox had no problem with what Tucker Carlson was doing for years and years and years.
sentences.zh: 而且从各方面来看，多年来，福克斯对塔克·卡尔森所做的事情一直没有意见。

sentences.en: Even when advertisers would get upset, which they sometimes did, they would boycott the show.
sentences.zh: 甚至当广告商会感到不满时，他们有时确实会这么做，他们会抵制这个节目。

sentences.en: So it was all OK, right?
sentences.zh: 所以一切都好，对吧？

sentences.en: Correct me if I'm wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果我弄错了请纠正我。

sentences.en: Until now.
sentences.zh: 直到现在。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: They knew they had the number one primetime show in cable news.
sentences.zh: 他们知道自己拥有有线新闻中收视率第一的黄金档节目。

sentences.en: They had a reliable revenue stream, not just from advertisers, though, as you correctly point out, a lot of them boycotted,
sentences.zh: 他们拥有可靠的收入来源，不仅来自广告商，尽管正如你正确指出的那样，其中很多广告商进行了抵制，

sentences.en: but from the enormous fees that Fox News is able to generate from subscribers to cable.
sentences.zh: 而是来自福克斯新闻能够从有线电视订户那里获得的大笔费用。

sentences.en: The breaking point seems to come this year as Fox News is defending itself against lawsuits
sentences.zh: 而转折点似乎出现在今年，当时福克斯新闻正在为自己应对诉讼进行辩护，

sentences.en: where Tucker Carlson's conduct off air is far more problematic for the network than what he said on the air.
sentences.zh: 在这些诉讼中，塔克·卡尔森在节目外的行为对该电视网来说，比他在节目中所说的话要麻烦得多。

sentences.en: And that's what we think pushed his bosses to pull the trigger on his firing so suddenly this week.
sentences.zh: 我们认为正是这一点促使他的老板们在本周如此突然地扣动了解雇他的扳机。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynaloo.
sentences.zh: 我是温妮洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的益智游戏之一“归类连线”（Connections）。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天都创作“拼字比赛”（Spelling Bee）和“字母方块”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So, Jeremy, describe this off-air conduct that's revealed in these lawsuits that appears to have contributed to Tucker Carlson's firing.
sentences.zh: 那么，杰里米，请描述一下这些在诉讼中被揭露的、似乎促成了塔克·卡尔森被解雇的幕后行为。

sentences.en: So, as of 6 p.m.
sentences.zh: 所以，截至今晚6点，

sentences.en: tonight, there's still a lot we don't know about why he got fired.
sentences.zh: 关于他为什么被解雇，我们仍然有很多未知数。

sentences.en: We do know that it was ordered from the highest levels of Fox and that Lachlan Murdoch, who's the CEO of Fox Corporation,
sentences.zh: 我们确实知道这是由福克斯最高层下令的，福克斯公司的首席执行官拉克兰·默多克，

sentences.en: and Suzanne Scott, the CEO of Fox News, decided that they were going to do this on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 以及福克斯新闻的首席执行官苏珊·斯科特，决定在周五晚上采取行动。

sentences.en: They inform Tucker of it on Monday morning, telling him, you're not on the air tonight.
sentences.zh: 他们在周一早上通知了塔克，告诉他，你今晚不上节目了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: No chance to say goodbye.
sentences.zh: 没有机会告别。

sentences.en: It's over.
sentences.zh: 一切都结束了。

sentences.en: In fact, in their news release announcing this, Fox says his last show was Friday.
sentences.zh: 事实上，福克斯在宣布这一消息的新闻稿中说，他的最后一期节目是在周五。

sentences.en: His last show was in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 他的最后一期节目已经成为了过去。

sentences.en: It's pretty unsentimental.
sentences.zh: 这相当冷酷无情。

sentences.en: Okay, so back to the lawsuits and the off-air comments that have perhaps led us to this point.
sentences.zh: 好吧，回到诉讼以及可能导致我们走到这一步的幕后言论上来。

sentences.en: Well, first, let's start with the Dominion case.
sentences.zh: 好吧，首先，让我们从多米尼恩案开始。

sentences.en: The biggest revelation about Tucker Carlson to come out of the Dominion case is that he reveals himself to be something of a political performance artiSt.
sentences.zh: 关于塔克·卡尔森从多米尼恩案中浮出水面的最大爆料是，他展现出自己某种程度上是个政治表演艺术家。

sentences.en: He's telling his audience one thing, but because of the emails and texts that Dominion is able to get as part of the case,
sentences.zh: 他在对观众说一套，但由于多米尼恩作为案件一部分能够获取的电子邮件和短信，

sentences.en: we know he doesn't believe some of the stuff that he's allowing on his air or telling his viewers that they're right to believe about voter fraud.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他并不相信他在节目中放任的某些东西，也不相信他告诉观众他们有权相信的关于选民欺诈的说法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Much of it relating to the claims that there's election fraud or that Dominion's voting machines played a role in election fraud.
sentences.zh: 其中很大一部分与声称存在选举欺诈或多米尼恩的投票机在选举欺诈中发挥了作用的说法有关。

sentences.en: We know he didn't believe any of it.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他根本不相信这些。

sentences.en: We also know from the Dominion suit that he loathes former President Trump.
sentences.zh: 我们还从多米尼恩诉讼中得知，他讨厌前总统特朗普。

sentences.en: He calls him all sorts of names, questions his judgment, says he can't wait for the day when they no longer have to talk about Trump and can ignore him.
sentences.zh: 他给他起各种绰号，质疑他的判断力，说他迫不及待地想要迎来再也不用谈论特朗普并且可以忽视他的那一天。

sentences.en: And this is the president, Tucker Carlson, has spent years elevating, promoting, and cheering on.
sentences.zh: 而这就是那个被塔克·卡尔森花了好几年时间去捧高、推广和欢呼的总统。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the president who, from what you're saying, is responsible for his success as a TV anchor.
sentences.zh: 而且按你所说，这个总统正是他作为电视主播取得成功的原因。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So that, I think, kind of points to his disingenuousness, that he's going to tell his audience what he thinks they want to hear.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为这在某种程度上指出了他的虚伪，即他会迎合观众，告诉他们他认为他们想听的话。

sentences.en: And it paid off because he's the most popular primetime host on all of Fox News.
sentences.zh: 这得到了回报，因为他是整个福克斯新闻中最受欢迎的黄金档主持人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But these emails and texts suddenly shake the foundation of that success.
sentences.zh: 但这些电子邮件和短信突然动摇了这种成功的基础。

sentences.en: They shatter the premise for those who were paying attention, and we're not sure many Fox viewers were, that he is this pro-working-class champion of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 对于那些一直关注此事的人来说，这打破了这样一个前提（我们不确定许多福克斯观众是否注意到了），即他是特朗普总统这位工人阶级拥护者的化身。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But we can assume that people who run Fox News were paying attention to this lawsuit and to the emails.
sentences.zh: 但我们可以假设，福克斯新闻的运营者一直在关注这场诉讼和这些电子邮件。

sentences.en: They were.
sentences.zh: 他们确实在关注。

sentences.en: And I'm told that they were also paying attention to some of the text messages between Tucker and his producers, in which they make fun of their colleagues.
sentences.zh: 有人告诉我，他们还关注了塔克和他的制片人之间的一些短信，他们在短信中嘲笑同事。

sentences.en: And they even question the judgment of their bosses.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至质疑自己老板的判断力。

sentences.en: What's an example of that, from the Dominion lawsuit, where Tucker Carlson and his producers are challenging their superiors?
sentences.zh: 从多米尼恩诉讼中来看，塔克·卡尔森和他的制片人挑战上级的一个例子是什么？

sentences.en: They really take issue with the Arizona call.
sentences.zh: 他们对亚利桑那州的预测结果提出了异议。

sentences.en: This is when the decision desk at Fox News got out of the gates earlier than any other news organization to say, President Biden's going to win Arizona.
sentences.zh: 当时福克斯新闻的决定台比任何其他新闻机构都更早地做出决定，宣布拜登总统将赢得亚利桑那州。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that was a huge moment because after that, it became very, very difficult to see how Trump could win a second term.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的时刻，因为在此之后，要看到特朗普如何赢得第二个任期变得非常非常困难。

sentences.en: Carlson says, effectively, I can't believe these people.
sentences.zh: 卡尔森基本上说，我真不敢相信这些人。

sentences.en: Don't they understand the damage that they're doing to this brand we spent years building?
sentences.zh: 难道他们不明白，他们正在对我们花费多年建立的这个品牌造成损害吗？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And he accuses some of them of being liberal sellouts, people who hate us, he says.
sentences.zh: 他指责他们中的一些人是自由派的叛徒，是那些恨我们的人，他说。

sentences.en: Even though they are his colleagues and bosses.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们是他的同事和老板。

sentences.en: That is correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The lawsuit from Dominion also opens a window into another aspect of his behavior that is alarming to many at Fox.
sentences.zh: 多米尼恩的诉讼还打开了一扇窗，让我们看到了他行为的另一个方面，这让福克斯的许多人感到震惊。

sentences.en: Which is?
sentences.zh: 是什么？

sentences.en: His misogynistic, especially the vulgar way in which he uses misogynistic language.
sentences.zh: 他的厌女症，特别是他使用厌女语言的粗俗方式。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: He says some words I won't repeat here, referring to Sidney Powell, one of President Trump's legal advisors that made people shudder once they saw them.
sentences.zh: 他说了我在这里不会重复的一些词，用来指代特朗普总统的法律顾问之一西德尼·鲍威尔，人们看到这些词时都感到不寒而栗。

sentences.en: That leads to a second lawsuit that unfolds as the Dominion case is getting ready to go to trial.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了第二起诉讼，这起诉讼在多米尼恩案准备开庭审理时展开。

sentences.en: Let's talk about this other lawsuit, Abby Grossberg's lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈这起由艾比·格罗斯伯格提起的诉讼。

sentences.en: A producer at Fox News sues Fox and Carlson, alleging that he has created, presided over, this incredibly toxic workplace.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻的一名制片人起诉了福克斯和卡尔森，称他创造并主导了一个极其有毒的工作场所。

sentences.en: Women were objectified.
sentences.zh: 女性被当成物件对待。

sentences.en: Female politicians who came on the show were mocked.
sentences.zh: 上节目的女政治家遭到嘲讽。

sentences.en: It was a game.
sentences.zh: 这成了一场游戏。

sentences.en: It was a sport.
sentences.zh: 这成了一项运动。

sentences.en: Where discrimination, sexism, anti-Semitism is all tolerated in a part of the everyday culture at Tucker Carlson Tonight.
sentences.zh: 在这里，歧视、性别歧视、反犹太主义都在《今夜塔克·卡尔森》的日常文化中受到容忍。

sentences.en: See, we're all the time.
sentences.zh: 看，我们一直都在这样。

sentences.en: She talks about a photo pinned up to a wall in the Tucker Carlson Tonight offices of Nancy Pelosi in this plunging bathing suit.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了一张贴在《今夜塔克·卡尔森》办公室墙上的南希·佩洛西穿着深V泳衣的照片。

sentences.en: This producer also alleges that right before Tudor Dixon, the Republican candidate for governor in Michigan, is set to come on Tucker Carlson's show,
sentences.zh: 这位制片人还指控称，就在密歇根州共和党州长候选人蒂多·迪克森准备上塔克·卡尔森的节目之前，

sentences.en: they have a mock debate about whether they would prefer to have sex with her, Dixon, or her Democratic opponent, Governor Gretchen Whitmer.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了一场模拟辩论，探讨他们是更愿意和迪克森发生性关系，还是和她的民主党对手、州长格雷琴·惠特默发生性关系。

sentences.en: So with this second lawsuit, we're talking about some very serious allegations, some very detailed allegations of basically a sexist, hostile workplace.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过这第二起诉讼，我们谈论的是一些非常严重的指控，关于一个基本上充满性别歧视、充满敌意的工作场所的一些非常详细的指控。

sentences.en: And the kind of claim that I have to imagine in a post-Roger Ailes Fox News, right, one where the company has already fired a senior executive for sexual harassment,
sentences.zh: 可以想象，在一个罗尔斯·艾尔斯之后的福克斯新闻，一个公司已经因性骚扰解雇了一名高级高管的环境下，

sentences.en: that this stuff gets taken pretty seriously.
sentences.zh: 这类事情会被相当严肃地对待。

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And part of Suzanne Scott's mission, once she took the helm of Fox News from Roger Ailes, was to make it a more friendly place for women to work.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·斯科特从罗尔斯·艾尔斯手中接掌福克斯新闻后，她的使命之一就是让这里成为一个对女性来说更友好的工作环境。

sentences.en: So it's not exactly a good look for her to have her star host and his staff behaving really horribly toward women.
sentences.zh: 因此，让她的明星主持人和他的员工对女性表现得如此糟糕，对她来说实在不是什么光彩的事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, Jimmy, how, based on all your reporting, does everything we're describing here come together in the minds of Fox leadership in their decision to get rid of Tucker Carlson?
sentences.zh: 那么，吉米，根据你所有的报道，我们这里描述的所有这一切，是如何在福克斯领导层的脑海中汇聚成他们解雇塔克·卡尔森的决定的？

sentences.en: Because there's a lot here in the mix.
sentences.zh: 因为这里面包含了很多因素。

sentences.en: So how do you see it?
sentences.zh: 所以你是怎么看的？

sentences.en: If you look at the history of recent high-profile firings of Fox News, Roger Ailes, as you just talked about, he was fired after being exposed as a serial predator of women.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看福克斯新闻最近几次备受瞩目的解雇历史，罗尔斯·艾尔斯，正如你刚才所说，他在被曝出是针对女性的连环色狼后被解雇。

sentences.en: Bill O'Reilly, its number one host, fired after multiple women accused him of egregious sexual misconduct.
sentences.zh: 比尔·奥赖利，其头牌主持人，在多名女性指控其严重的性行为不端后被解雇。

sentences.en: Their firings didn't have anything to do with what was said on the air, what they allowed on their shows.
sentences.zh: 他们的解雇与节目中说的话、他们在节目中允许的内容没有任何关系。

sentences.en: And I think that's important in putting into context what happened to Tucker Carlson.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对于理解塔克·卡尔森遭遇的事情的背景很重要。

sentences.en: For four years during Trump's presidency and for two years after, Tucker Carlson said some outrageously inflammatory, racially insensitive, outright at times racist things.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统任期的四年里以及之后的两年里，塔克·卡尔森说过一些极其煽动性、对种族不敏感、有时甚至是彻头彻尾的种族主义的话。

sentences.en: And he still had a job.
sentences.zh: 而他当时依然保住了工作。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: So, if I can summarize what you're saying here, what gets you in trouble at a place like Fox, which is so fixated on its ratings and its audience, is always, at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我能总结你刚才所说的话，在福克斯这样一家如此痴迷于收视率和观众的地方，最终真正会让你陷入麻烦的是，

sentences.en: not going too far with that pursuit of ratings and that pursuit of audience, but with plain old human resource violations of the most basic kind.
sentences.zh: 倒不是在追求收视率和观众群体上走得太远，而是涉及最基本的人力资源违规问题。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: But the big question around firing Tucker Carlson is, is it going to hurt Fox?
sentences.zh: 但关于解雇塔克·卡尔森，最大的问题是，这会伤害福克斯吗？

sentences.en: And maybe their rationale makes total sense.
sentences.zh: 也许他们的理由完全合乎情理。

sentences.en: Maybe their lawyers advised them that they needed to do it.
sentences.zh: 也许他们的律师建议他们必须这样做。

sentences.en: But as Tucker Carlson said in one of the text messages that you've talked to me about on this show, when you're Fox, you cannot alienate your viewers.
sentences.zh: 但正如塔克·卡尔森在您之前在节目中跟我谈到过的一条短信中所说的那样，当你是福克斯时，你不能疏远你的观众。

sentences.en: That relationship is sacrosanct and it is delicate.
sentences.zh: 这种关系是神圣不可侵犯的，也是脆弱的。

sentences.en: In firing Tucker, is Fox at all risking disrupting that bond with its viewers?
sentences.zh: 在解雇塔克时，福克斯是否在冒着破坏与观众之间这种纽带的风险？

sentences.en: They are.
sentences.zh: 他们确实在冒这个险。

sentences.en: But at the same time, they're making a gamble that has paid off for them in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他们也在下一场赌局，而这在过去曾为他们带来过回报。

sentences.en: Tucker Carlson isn't the first high-profile figure at Fox who's been fired.
sentences.zh: 塔克·卡尔森并不是福克斯被解雇的第一个知名人物。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Bill O'Reilly.
sentences.zh: 比尔·奥赖利。

sentences.en: Glenn Beck.
sentences.zh: 格伦·贝克。

sentences.en: Glenn Beck, the Tea Party star.
sentences.zh: 格伦·贝克，茶党明星。

sentences.en: And Glenn Beck's sin, along with Sarah Palins, who was also fired by Fox.
sentences.zh: 而格伦·贝克的罪过，以及同样被福克斯解雇的萨拉·佩林的罪过。

sentences.en: As a contributor, right?
sentences.zh: 作为撰稿人，对吧？

sentences.en: Their sins were that they thought they were bigger than Fox.
sentences.zh: 他们的罪过在于他们自认为比福克斯更重要。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Fox wants these hosts to know that no one is ever bigger than the network itself.
sentences.zh: 福克斯想让这些主持人明白，任何人永远都不会比电视台本身更重要。

sentences.en: Tucker Carlson thought he was bigger than the network.
sentences.zh: 塔克·卡尔森曾以为自己比电视台更大牌。

sentences.en: This is a guy, remember, who's floated as a possible presidential contender.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，这家伙曾被炒作为潜在的总统候选人。

sentences.en: However, he's quoted on the record saying that no one tells him what to do.
sentences.zh: 然而，有记录显示他曾公开表示没有人能对他的工作指手画脚。

sentences.en: He can put whatever he wants, essentially, into his scripts.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他想在剧本里写什么就能写什么。

sentences.en: Well, what Fox News said on Monday is, no, you're not bigger than Fox.
sentences.zh: 嗯，福克斯新闻周一的表态是：不，你没有福克斯大。

sentences.en: Here's the door.
sentences.zh: 请走不送。

sentences.en: And by the way, you are only who you are because we gave you that 8 p.m.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，你之所以有今天，全因我们给了你晚上8点

sentences.en: time slot.
sentences.zh: 的黄金时段。

sentences.zh: 但我相当确信，历史也已经证明，他们完全可以把一个相对知名度不高、未经检验的

sentences.en: person into that very highly rated slot, and it'll probably do well because there's just so many people who watch Fox.
sentences.zh: 人放到那个收视率极高的时段，节目大概率也会办得很好，因为看福克斯的人实在太多了。

sentences.en: And Fox is so good at giving its audience what it wants.
sentences.zh: 而且福克斯非常擅长给观众提供他们想要的东西。

sentences.en: It doesn't necessarily have to be Tucker Carlson in the anchor chair doing that.
sentences.zh: 坐在主播椅上做这件事的人，不一定非得是塔克·卡尔森。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The lesson here being from Fox, we can make you, and we can break you, and then we can replace you and do the whole thing all over again.
sentences.zh: 福克斯给我们的教训是：我们能成就你，也能毁掉你，然后我们还能取代你，把这一切从头再来一遍。

sentences.en: And that is something that the Murdochs have always shown they are not afraid of doing.
sentences.zh: 默多克家族一向表现出他们并不害怕这样做。

sentences.en: So, if we know that there's a Fox without Tucker Carlson, I guess the question becomes, is there a Tucker Carlson without Fox?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们知道没有塔克·卡尔森的福克斯依然存在，我想问题就成了：没有福克斯的塔克·卡尔森还存在吗？

sentences.en: Well, as is usually the case with multi-million dollar contracts like he has, there's a non-compete.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如他这种数百万美元合同通常会出现的情况一样，这里有竞业禁止条款。

sentences.en: So, he will have restrictions on what he is able to do, and it may preclude any type of television for quite some time.
sentences.zh: 因此，他对能做什么会受到限制，这可能会在相当长一段时间内排除他参与任何类型电视节目的可能。

sentences.en: That doesn't mean that he's done.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着他就此完蛋了。

sentences.en: But, you know, in the case of Glenn Beck and Bill O'Reilly, you don't really hear much about them anymore.
sentences.zh: 不过，你知道的，就格伦·贝克和比尔·奥赖利而言，你现在基本上听不到太多关于他们的消息了。

sentences.en: I mean, yes, they have shows, they have followings, the loyal diehards who always tuned in when they were on Fox, but that's a much smaller audience now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，是的，他们有节目，有粉丝，有那些当他们在福克斯时总是准时收看的忠实死忠粉，但现在的受众规模要小得多了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is a good lesson for every journalist out there.
sentences.zh: 这对在座的每一位记者来说都是一个很好的教训。

sentences.en: I mean, what are you without the platform of your news organization?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果没有新闻机构这个平台，你算什么呢？

sentences.en: That's the lesson here.
sentences.zh: 这就是这里的教训。

sentences.en: It's very humbling.
